name: Stone Sleeper
description: Explore documented stećci and compose a source-aware 2D stone design with historically grounded motifs.

store.tagline: Explore real stećci, read inscriptions and design a stone of your own.
store.description: A source-linked introduction to medieval stećci: explore their regional distribution, real photographs, necropolis records, and historically cautious notes on belief, motifs and stoneworking. The Kočerinska entry pairs the real inscribed stone with a Latin-script transcription, modern-language renderings and translations. In the design studio, compose a 2D stećak from scalable, AI-assisted interpretive motif drawings, write and place an inscription, choose artificial ageing, and download your named design as SVG. Upload or draw motifs; simple image cutout is local threshold-based processing, not AI recognition. Optional community submissions are visible to users of this Möbius instance. This is an educational creative tool, not a scholarly text edition or archaeological reconstruction.
